### Observed differences

- In the later window, A27 appears in about 46% of traces (91/200) instead of 100%, while A32 and A33 each appear in about 55% of traces (109/200), having been absent or nearly absent before. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006]
- A26 remains in essentially all traces, but its outgoing transitions shift: before, about 98% went to A27; after, about 44% go to A27, 33% to A33, and 20% to A32. [DIR002]
- A32 and A33 now lead into A28: A32 transitions go to A28 (61%) and A33 (39%); A33 transitions go to A32 (61%) and A28 (38%). A28 is still present in every trace, and the A26-to-A28 gap changes from mostly 2 steps to mostly 3 steps. [DIR003, DIR004, REL014, REL015, LAG002]
- Before, A27 always co-occurred with A28 and preceded it; after, A27 and A28 co-occur in only about 46% of traces, and in the remaining 55% A28 appears without A27. [REL009, REL010, REL011]
- A04 participation falls from about 29% to 11%; A43 transitions to A04 fall from about 30% to 3%, while A43 to A44 rises from about 68% to 93%. [OCC001, DIR005]
- A23 participation falls from about 59% to 41%, while A24 rises from about 42% to 60%. [OCC002, OCC003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in which the previously universal A26→A27→A28 sequence is partly replaced by a variant that goes through A32/A33 before A28, and the A43→A04→A44 branch is largely replaced by direct A43→A44. The signs are consistent: A27 participation halves while A32/A33 appear in the same ~55% of traces; A26's successor distribution shifts from A27 to A33/A32; A28 remains universal; the A26-to-A28 lag moves from 2 to 3 steps; and A43's successor share to A04 drops sharply while A44 increases. The main limitation is that the order between A32 and A33 is not fixed (both A32-before-A33 and A33-before-A32 occur), and the A04-related lag evidence after the change rests on few traces, so the exact internal order of the new branch is less certain. The evidence cannot rule out that the new branch has two order variants rather than one fixed sequence. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL014, REL015, LAG002, OCC001, DIR005]
